name: Tether USD

regulatory_status.status: Not authorized as an EMT — Tether has publicly declined to pursue MiCA authorization, citing objections to reserve-composition rules; multiple EU exchanges have delisted or restricted USDT for EU users since 2024, with further forced conversions reported into mid-2026.

description: The largest fiat-backed stablecoin by market cap, issued by Tether. Not authorized as a MiCA Electronic Money Token in the EU.
